invariants.scope: pure index-engine mathematics; no MoSPI, DGCA or other external data involved

checks.name: uniform_scaling_linearity
checks.detail: all prices x alpha moves the Laspeyres index by exactly alpha*100

checks.name: base_period_identity
checks.detail: P_t == P_0 implies Laspeyres == Paasche == Fisher == 100

checks.name: fisher_geometric_mean_and_bounds
checks.detail: Fisher == sqrt(L*P) and stays within [min(L,P), max(L,P)]

checks.name: weighted_median_scalar_identity
checks.detail: equal prices collapse the weighted median to that price

holdout_week.note: Relationship fitted on the first 28 days predicts the final 7 days; the three in-window benchmark anchors are the only external input.
holdout_week.holdout_r_reason: prediction is constant across the holdout week, so correlation is undefined; the benchmark interpolant is clamped at the last anchor (mid-month of the final benchmark month) and has no variation inside the holdout week. Level agreement is reported as MAPE/MAE.

lead_lag.note: Positive lag means the APIx value at t+lag matches the benchmark at t, i.e. APIx moved first. Uses only the three in-window anchors.

scope_note: Sections beyond the invariants stress the relationship already implied by the three in-window benchmark anchors. They add no MoSPI observations and do not change r=0.9569 over n=3 overlapping months.
